# ImpossibleLabs

> A hardware and software studio turning wild ideas into real products. Open source by default.

## About

ImpossibleLabs is a tech studio by OxMarco. We turn absurd ideas into reality, combining hardware and software to build experimental projects. Our philosophy is inspired by M.C. Escher: "Only those who attempt the absurd will achieve the impossible."

## What We Do

- Hardware prototyping and development
- Software engineering and open source contributions
- Experimental tech projects
- Creative technology exploration

## Products

- [CashOrTrash](https://cashortrash.fun): a guess-the-price game for iOS and Android. Bet a price range, not a number; the tighter the range, the bigger the score. Daily challenge, head-to-head matches and quick rounds. Server code: https://github.com/OxMarco/CashOrTrash
- [Quiesco](https://quiesco.rest): an open-source bedroom environment monitor that measures CO₂, temperature, humidity, light and noise, with an e-ink screen and a Bluetooth companion app. No Wi-Fi, no cloud. Hardware, firmware and app: https://github.com/OxMarco/Quiesco
- [BlueBaħar](https://bluebahar.com): notices to mariners, hazards, restricted zones, protected areas and weather forecasts around Malta on one map. Free on iOS and Android, no account, no ads.

## Experiments

Hardware and radio projects, all open source: Lyft (gym tracker for powerlifters), Portable BadUSB (ATtiny85 HID exploit), Micro GSM Network (2G with LimeNET and osmocom), Ethereum LoRa (long-range radio interface for Ethereum nodes) and a LoRa P2P network.
